request.system:
You merge candidate themes that were proposed independently from four batches of call transcripts at Aegis Cloud Security.

Input: a JSON object with "themes" (each has a source id like "b2.t3", a name, definition, distinguishing, owner, actionable_because, and the number of calls) and "product_areas" (each has a source id like "b1.p2" and a name).

Task:
1. Merge themes that are the same idea under different wording into one consolidated theme. Keep themes that are genuinely different separate. Return at most 12 consolidated themes.
2. For each consolidated theme give: name (2 to 5 words), definition (one sentence), distinguishing (one sentence versus its nearest neighbor), owner (one of "support lead", "sales / account manager", "product manager", "engineering lead"), actionable_because (one sentence), and merged_from (the list of source ids it combines).
3. Every theme source id must appear in exactly one merged_from list, or in "dropped" with a one-sentence reason (use dropping only for a theme that fails the actionability test: no stakeholder would act on a pattern of such calls). Do not invent source ids.
4. Merge the product areas the same way: canonical name as the speakers use it, and merged_from source ids. Every product-area source id appears in exactly one list.
5. other_note: one or two sentences on what the batches say about calls that fit no theme.

Return only JSON matching the schema.

themes.name: Pipeline Outage Technical Remediation
themes.definition: Calls addressing the architectural investigation, redundant node failover, circuit breaker implementation, and technical root-cause remediation of the Detect event ingestion pipeline outage.
themes.distinguishing: Focuses strictly on engineering root causes, infrastructure fixes, and pipeline recovery rather than commercial account retention or customer relationship management.
themes.actionable_because: Engineering leads must deploy redundant ingestion nodes, rearchitect single points of failure, and adjust circuit breaker thresholds to prevent future cascade failures.

themes.name: Post Outage Account Retention
themes.definition: Calls where customers demand SLAs, executive briefings, credits, and remediation documentation following monitoring downtime, creating elevated churn and competitive risk.
themes.distinguishing: Focuses on commercial damage control, customer trust restoration, and SLA negotiations rather than internal technical debugging or general renewal discussions.
themes.actionable_because: Account managers can provide executive architecture briefings, offer commercial concessions, and supply formal remediation reports to prevent at-risk accounts from churning.

themes.name: Comply v2 Feature Adoption
themes.definition: Calls involving product previews, onboarding readiness, sales demos, and early adoption tracking for Comply v2 multi-framework on-demand reporting.
themes.distinguishing: Centers on adoption and capability education for standard Comply v2 functionality rather than post-launch bug triage or custom template requests.
themes.actionable_because: Product managers can track multi-framework adoption metrics, validate GA performance readiness, and guide product packaging.

themes.name: Comply Post Launch Defects
themes.definition: Calls focused on diagnosing and resolving software bugs, query timeouts, export formatting errors, and billing discrepancies following migration to Comply v2.
themes.distinguishing: Addresses functional code defects, system timeouts, and billing errors in Comply rather than adoption planning or feature roadmap requests.
themes.actionable_because: Engineering leads must deploy hotfixes for pagination queries, resolve report generation timeouts, and correct billing calculation logic.

themes.name: Custom Compliance Reporting Requests
themes.definition: Calls where customers explicitly request custom control frameworks, bespoke cross-framework matrices, and non-standard reporting templates.
themes.distinguishing: Focuses on future product expansion for non-standard, custom compliance templates rather than standard Comply v2 adoption or bug fixing.
themes.actionable_because: Product managers can evaluate customer requirements, prioritize custom reporting template engines, and recruit design partners.

themes.name: Contract Renewal and Expansion
themes.definition: Commercial discussions covering scheduled renewals, seat expansion, multi-year commitments, tier upgrades, and cross-selling additional platform modules.
themes.distinguishing: Focuses on standard contract renewals and commercial expansion terms rather than acute post-outage retention saves.
themes.actionable_because: Account managers can structure multi-year renewal proposals, configure module bundles, and reconcile overage tiers to drive expansion revenue.

themes.name: Competitive Strategy and Positioning
themes.definition: Internal calls evaluating competitive threats, competitor displacement tactics, deal win-loss reviews, and sales battlecards against rivals like SentinelShield and CyberNova.
themes.distinguishing: Focuses on internal competitive analysis and objection handling across the market rather than individual commercial contract renewal terms.
themes.actionable_because: Sales leaders can update battlecards, train reps on competitor counter-messaging, and adapt pricing strategies to win competitive evaluations.

themes.name: Detect Tuning and Noise Optimization
themes.definition: Calls focused on configuring behavioral baselines, suppressing false-positive spikes, and tuning detection thresholds to minimize operational alert fatigue.
themes.distinguishing: Deals with the behavioral calibration and sensitivity of detection rules during normal operation rather than catastrophic pipeline outages.
themes.actionable_because: Support leads can guide customers through rule suppression best practices and collaborate with engineering to reset corrupted baselines.

themes.name: Ingestion Pipeline Latency and Bottlenecks
themes.definition: Calls addressing event latency, alert delivery delays, connector queue depth imbalances, and SIEM webhook timeouts within the Detect streaming pipeline.
themes.distinguishing: Deals with partial degradation, connector latency, and queue backpressure rather than total system-wide service outages.
themes.actionable_because: Engineering leads can rebalance tenant queue distribution, adjust streaming buffer parameters, and resolve webhook connector timeouts.

themes.name: Identity Provisioning and Authentication
themes.definition: Calls concerning directory synchronization queues, SAML SSO authentication regressions, session timeouts, and SCIM or JIT provisioning feature requirements in Aegis Identity.
themes.distinguishing: Focuses exclusively on Identity module defects, authentication configurations, and IAM feature gaps rather than Detect or Protect platform issues.
themes.actionable_because: Product managers can prioritize SAML authentication fixes, adaptive MFA policies, and SCIM endpoint enhancements on the identity roadmap.

themes.name: Protect Scalability and Backup Failures
themes.definition: Calls addressing degraded backup throughput, snapshot deduplication bottlenecks, orchestration failures, and missing granular restore capabilities in Aegis Protect.
themes.distinguishing: Focuses specifically on storage architecture, snapshot throughput, and restore limitations within the Protect product area.
themes.actionable_because: Engineering leads can refactor the job scheduler queue, optimize snapshot deduplication, and schedule granular restore capabilities.

themes.name: Customer Module Onboarding Architecture
themes.definition: Structured implementation and kickoff sessions assisting customers with initial environment discovery, architecture scoping, and policy deployment for newly purchased modules.
themes.distinguishing: Centers on initial deployment setup and onboarding project planning rather than resolving existing bugs or negotiating renewals.
themes.actionable_because: Support leads can develop structured implementation checklists, API configuration templates, and discovery guides to reduce time-to-value.
